### Moto: Love, Joy, and Service

Beginnings: In the year 1978 S.V.D Priests working in Medak District (A.P. Archdiocese of Hyderabad) invited the JMJ sisters to collaborate with them in the work of evangelization.

Medak district is one of the most backward districts in Telangana Andhra Pradesh. The JMJs were looking forward to extend their services to backward areas where Christian influence had not yet reached. This collaboration was to be a starting point to get to know the place and the people. The JMJs are trying to reach the most neglected corners and making themselves available to the needs of the area. The Catholics migrated from coastal Andhra were completely left to themselves and grew weak in faith. People (even Catholics) believed in black magic, witchcraft and superstitions. There was no Church in the villages except in one or two places. The pioneering sisters had no proper residence and no proper means of transport and the sisters had to walk a good distance in the hot sun very often.

The persistent, persevering and undaunted determination of the sisters brought to go forward in the mission of evangelization. With regular visits to villages, conducting prayer meetings, breaking the Word of God, instructing in religion and identifying themselves with the locals, their needs, living with them, our sisters could win the good will of the people.

In 1979 for the school-going age girls from villages, the SVD priests arranged boarding home and lodging facility in Gajwel. The children were sent to the local government school. M.J. Sisters were in charge of the boarding home.

In the year 1983 a Telugu Medium High School is started, the first Christian School in Gajwel. We had 120 children studying from 1st to 5th standard and later on it is upgraded into High School. Now we have very committed and dedicated staff. Only the classes from 6th to 10th is aided, where the salaries of the staff are paid by the government & salaries for elementary school staff and all other expenses and facilities have to be provided by the management/sisters. The school is functioning very satisfactorily, with good academic standards and has changed the image of Gajwel for good.

In the year 2014, the management felt the need of starting English Medium parallel to Telugu Medium. From the humble beginning we made in 1983 having crossed 37 memorable mile stones, today our school has face LIFT towards value oriented education for our students, teachers, and parents alike. We started the English Medium with modern facilities and innovative methods – Joyful learning. It is the vision of our Pioneer sisters who worked tirelessly and the hard work of our correspondents, principles, staff and the well wishers. At present we have 600 students coming from 24 different remote villages nearby. Our motto is to reach out to the unreached in giving quality education.

In this School Profile, you come across our new endeavors in various directions. Apart from academics we have ensured the participation of the student in all school activities where they can do their best in all the areas. As educator it is our duty to stimulate our student’s curiosity and help them to be a lifelong learner.

#### Our Vision

The vision of the school is to provide all round education and nurture a child’s innate curiosity and train the child intellectually, morally and socially to achieve excellence in life.

#### Our Mission

We train youngsters to face the challenges of personal and social life by providing them quality education at affordable cost. We teach and guide our students through various programs to become liberated individuals who will be the pride of our great nation INDIA.

#### FRONTIER MISSION

“Great things happen when God mixes with us”

Yes, this is true to our St. Joseph’s High School, Gajwel. As the years pass by various changes have taken place in the education system all over Telangana State. There was drastic fall of the strength in the Private sector. But we the JMJ sisters keep in our heart the origin of the founding school in Gajwel. So, we have taken the elementary school children as St. Joseph’s target children with full free of cost, giving them a bright future for their all round development. In the academic year 2020-2021 these targeted children are merged into English Medium, which is our Frontier Mission – to be at the side of the poor and backward girl children.

##### ST. THERESA’S HOSPITAL – SANATHNAGAR – HYDERABAD

St.Theresa’s Hospital is started has its roots in a small Dispensary that catered to suburban patients in Somajiguda in the year 1960. In that place primary preventive, Nursing Care was given to the patients. Over the decades, this Dispensary was shifted to Sanathnagar and converted into a General Hospital for the community administered by the JMJ Sisters named after St.Theresa’s Hospital.

St.Theresa’s General Hospital is charitable institution belonging to and run by the Society of Jesus Mary and Joseph. It was officially opened on 25th of February 1974. With the passage of time, innovations in medicine and a burgeoning population brought about an evolution that transformed the institution into a multi-specialty hospital that has also nurtured as multi-specialty and academic tradition. Just as illness is blind to social and economic considerations, we believe that affordable healthcare is a basic right of everyone.

There is a team of highly qualified and committed Medical, Nursing and Para Medical staff working with the hospital presently. The Hospital caters to upper, middle and lower class people and also the under-privileged ones. The Hospital also has facility for full time morning and evening consultations and surgeries. The Hospital values to a great extent through the services rendered from its Community Health Department which works with motto of “Health for many more by many more”. Yes, we have come a long way since our humble beginnings. The hospital has been registered for Post-graduate studies in the Specialties of General Medicine, General Surgery, Orthopedics and Obstetrics & Gynecology. The young doctors are being trained to obtain their Diploma of National Board DBN), a Post-graduation Degree. Hospital also has the agreement with Texila American University to take the Post-MBBS students for the MD Course for three years for the training and Clinicals. At the same time there is RSSDI Course Diabetes affiliated to Jaipur University for two years Diploma Course.

Constantly raising the bar, we achieved significant milestones in the year 2015, when we inaugurated the Cathlab and Modular Cardio-thoracic Operation Theatre for Cardiac Surgeries with its cutting edge cardiac catheterization laboratory, MRI, 15 Slides Spiral CT Scan and other advanced medical equipment.

After working tireless and developing the policies and protocols for the different departments, close observation of the quality team, and inspections of the NABH team finally the hospital achieved the NABH Accreditation Certificate in the year 2019 March 31st for St.Theresa’s Hospital. We cheer up and congrats to all those contributed this great milestone in the History of St.Theresa’s Multi-Specialty Hospital.

##### MISSION

“To bear witness to Christ Compassionate Love with sensitive and comprehensive Nursing care to the poorest and most abandoned among the sick”.

##### AIM

“Assurances of total health services, both preventive and curative with high professional’s skills and dedicated apostolic enthusiasm and care are the overall objective of St.Theresa’s Hospital. The focus is on the needy, especially on those who are socially and economically handicapped.”

##### TENDER LOVING CARE HOME (TLC HOME) - SANATHNAGAR

Life is God’s greatest gift to mankind. One of the most wonderful sights we can hope to see the world is that of a healthy and happy child. Each and every child is a promise, a promise that what is best about us will thrive, and what is wrong can be made right.

Rapid growth and phenomenal increase in the population of the world, the number of unwanted and abandoned children has also increased in every nation.

The solution of their personal salvation and the health of the nation is the same, namely abandoned children into family units in the early years of their life. And the realization of this fact is what prompted Sr. Theresa Maria to start the St.Theresaa’s Tender Loving Care Home.

Originally started in 1986 for taking care of abandoned children, the Tender Loving Care Home, attached to St.Theresa’s Hospital, has become an adoption center for children. Ten years later, in September 1996 the Home received a License for inter-country adoption. During that time 70 children adopted by Indian parents and 56 children were adopted by foreigners, 62 children left behind at home were girls with 25 dedicated staff to take care of them.

The newly constructed, centrally air-conditioned building for the Home, perhaps the only one of its kind in the country was inaugurated by the first Lady of the State of Andhra Pradesh, Dr. Haripriya Rangarajan, on 20.01.1999.

The heart and soul of the Home is a band of dedicated staff and selfless and committed volunteers whose untiring efforts keep the Homegoing always in high spirits.

The home continued to take great pains to provide a secure environment as well as the necessary love and care in bringing up the children in a socially and psychologically well-adjusted atmosphere. In this effort, the Home has generous benefactors even today joining hands together.

Many children who landed in the Home had problems of one type or other, but with untiring efforts and constant care they are healthy today and it is the smile on the children’s face, the glint in their eyes and the prayer that they can look forward to love, understanding and a bright future, which drive us ever onward in our endeavor to care for the abandoned children.

Till 2014, girls got the opportunity to go for adoption and many of them went for adoption. But 9 of the girls could not go for adoption, now TLC HOME is taking complete responsibility of these girls by educating and giving all round development for their better future.

We thank God for His wonderful deeds till the end.

##### Brief History

Jyothinilayam Convent, the abode of light and life is situated in the heart of Pearl City, Hyderabad. Though it is surrounded by the hustle and bustle of the city, it has got its own serenity and sanctity.

It has undergone great many changes during its existence from the time of its establishment. When it was inaugurated on 26 May 1975, it was meant for the senior most sisters of India, and the Convent was named as “Shanthinilayam”. After the division of Indian Province into 3 Provinces, the sweet home of senior sisters’ Shanthinilayam, Somajiguda was converted into “Formation House” of Hyderabad Province in 1991, and renamed as “Jyothinilayam”. The aged sisters were shifted to St.Theresa’s Convent, Sanathnagar. Again on 31st October 1997, for the administrative convenience, Provincialate was shifted to Jyothinilayam and Formation House was shifted to Manoharabad, the sub urban area of Hyderabad.

So when we glance through the history of Jyothinilayam, we see that for 12 years, this house accommodated mature and seasoned religious, filled with prayer and sanctity, for another 10 years. Young vibrant Aspiring farmers were here empowered to respond to their call gracefully. Finally, since 1997, the Provincial Council is sending vibrations of the spirit, charism and spirituality of JMJ to all over the Hyderabad Province, from this House of the Lord – Jyothinilayam.

The present Jyothinilayam Convent, Somajiguda is attached to Provincialate and has its own Superior and 15 sisters as inmates. It has no direct apostolate and consists of sisters staff engaged in the Provincialate office and student sisters studying in Hyderabad. Student sisters of the Province living outside the JMJ community of Hyderabad Province as well as sisters working in the Mission abroad belong to Jyothinilayam.

##### JMJ SNEHA SADAN - “A HOME AWAY FROM HOME”

Seeing the plight of the children roaming about begging at the railway stations, bus stands and traffic lights of the twin cities Hyderabad and Secunderabad, was the beginning of our Home for the Street Children. Sr.Adriana Plakkal initiated the Project by discussing on doing something for these unfortunate children in consultation and full support of the then Rev.Sr.Martin Maliekal Provincial Superior and her Council. It was then that the goodness and generosity of late Dr. B.V. Raju the Padma Bhushan Awards gifted a piece of his land in Miyapur and his financial support for the building came as a boon to realize the cherished dream of starting a Home for the Street Children at present “JMJ Sneha Sadan” in Miyapur. The target group of the beneficiaries is girl children from different sources – from the streets, contacted and picked up by sisters, referred by some organizations, unwanted and neglected children brought by some active social workers, responsible citizens and helpful neighbours. The humble beginning of the home was initiated by Sr. Adriana Plakkal and Sr. Christopher Mallavarapu (late).

The children are well cared for, loved and provided with opportunities to grow up happily. As these children are devoid of their normal childhood facilities, they are found to be very naughty, aggressive, moody, sad, troublesome and possessive in the beginning. As they received love, care and guidance, they slowly opened up their life story which indeed is very painful to hear. They are given counselling and guidance for their self-acceptance and character formation. Some of these children are sent for bridge course and others are enrolled in different Schools mostly supported by the Government. It is heart-warming to see the children enjoying their childhood and growing up into helpful citizens.

As the years went by the JMJ Sneha Sadan are well known in the area and the generosity of the sponsors/well-wishers helped the Management to enrol the children in better Schools according to their aptitude and ability. Now the sisters experience the support and assistance of well-wishers, friends and neighbours, sponsors to help these children’s education. For the Society of JMJ, Hyderabad J.M.J Junior College is one of the milestones in the apostolate of education. This is the first establishment of the Soc. of J.M.J in the Soc. of J.M.J in the Diocese of Warangal. JMJs are identified with Social Apostolate right from the inception of the Society. The Charism, an Ever Adoptable Apostolic Availability, bequeathed to the JMJs by our Founder Fr.Mathias Wolff S.J., opened new vistas for us to launch out to the Social Apostolate as per the signs of the times. No doubt, if we review the Social Apostolate as was practiced at the start of the Society, it is very different from what it is today. The activities of the JMJSSS are inspired and based on the Word of God and social teachings of the Church.
